clauses.title: Unauthorized transactions
clauses.text: If the customer reports a transaction they did not make or authorize, the transaction amount is refunded as a provisional credit, the card is blocked and a replacement is issued.

clauses.title: Repeated unauthorized claims
clauses.text: If the customer has raised two or more unauthorized-transaction disputes in the last 12 months, the case is escalated to the fraud team instead of being refunded automatically.

clauses.title: Scope of card disputes
clauses.text: This policy covers disputes about card transactions on Northwind consumer accounts: duplicate charges, goods or services not received, unauthorized transactions, incorrect amounts and refunds not processed by the merchant. A dispute must reference a specific transaction on the customer's account.

clauses.title: Filing window
clauses.text: A dispute must be raised within 90 days of the transaction date. Disputes raised after 90 days are rejected, except for unauthorized transactions on accounts flagged for fraud review, which are escalated.

clauses.title: Transaction must be identified
clauses.text: If no transaction on the customer's account matches the merchant, amount or date described, the agent must ask the customer for the transaction date, merchant name and amount before any decision is made.

clauses.title: Human review threshold
clauses.text: Any refund above 300 EUR, any case where the agent's confidence is low, and any case involving suspected fraud must be reviewed by a human dispute officer before the customer is notified.
